page.content:
The Astra (or Astra Planeta) are five gods of the wandering stars or planets. They are the children of Eos, the goddess of dawn, and Astraios, the titan of astronomy.

page.overview:
Who is The Astra?

The Astra (or Astra Planeta) are five gods of the wandering stars or planets. They are the children of Eos, the goddess of dawn, and Astraios, the titan of astronomy.
